title: Pool Table | GYM | GATED Parking | Sleeps 10
description:
Welcome to your Germantown getaway! Just 5 minutes from Downtown Nashville, this stay offers comfort and convenience for up to 10 guests. Enjoy the pool table for fun evenings in, a fully equipped kitchen for all your cooking needs and the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer. Stay connected with 1 gig WiFi, and rest easy with free gated parking. Whether you’re here to explore the city or relax, this is the perfect spot for your Nashville stay!

Other things to note
IMPORTANT NOTES BEFORE YOU BOOK:
1. Building amenities such as the pool and gym are managed by the apartment complex and may occasionally be unavailable due to maintenance, repairs, or seasonal closures beyond our control. Availability is not guaranteed at all times. Please note that no refunds or discounts will be provided if any amenities are temporarily unavailable during your stay.
2. Since the home includes a pool table, the dining table is relatively small and may not provide enough space for larger family dinners or group meals.

This spacious gated, first-floor apartment is ideal for families and groups, offering a comfortable and private retreat with plenty of entertainment. Enjoy access to a seasonal pool and seasonal barbecue grill for a well-rounded experience. Inside, challenge your friends to a game on the pool table or unwind in the cozy living area with a Smart TV and lightning-fast 1 Gbps Wi-Fi.

Sleep comfortably on our 3 queen beds, sleeper sofa and a king inflatable mattress perfect for families or friends traveling together. The fully stocked kitchen has all the essentials for cooking and sharing meals. Whether you’re here for a weekend or an extended stay, this stylish apartment has everything you need for a memorable Nashville experience.
